title: Make Time Visible
prompt:
**This week: make time visible.**

Build a page that shows the current time — but not with a boring clock face. Color, words, motion, planets, sand, decay: anything, as long as someone can actually tell roughly what time it is.

The only rule: it must reflect the real current time, live.

People vote on these side by side. The generic version loses — make it yours.

You're done when it's something you'd leave open on a second monitor.
